Combine parsed sources and resolve ambiguous sequences

Source: R/parse.R
rb_combine_resolve.Rd

Functions to combine multiple standardized source tables and resolve sequences that are assigned to multiple species.

  • rb_combine_sources(): Combines parsed source tables and removes duplicated species-sequence combinations.

  • rb_resolve_ambiguous(): Detects and resolves sequences assigned to multiple species.

Usage

rb_combine_sources(
  source_list,
  species_col = "species",
  sequence_col = "sequence"
)

rb_resolve_ambiguous(
  data,
  species_col = "species",
  sequence_col = "sequence",
  resolution_table = NULL,
  on_unresolved = "stop",
  flag_output_path = NULL
)

Arguments

source_list

List of standardized source data frames.

species_col

Name of the species column. Default "species".

sequence_col

Name of the sequence column. Default "sequence".

data

Standardized data frame to check for ambiguous sequences.

resolution_table

Optional data frame resolving ambiguous sequences. Must contain an action column with values "keep", "combine", or "drop".

on_unresolved

Action to take when ambiguous sequences are found and no resolution_table is supplied. One of "stop", "warn", or "drop". Default "stop".

flag_output_path

Optional path to write ambiguous rows for manual review before resolving.

Value

  • rb_combine_sources() returns a combined data frame with duplicated species-sequence combinations removed.

  • rb_resolve_ambiguous() returns the input data frame with ambiguous rows removed or replaced according to the resolution_table (or on_unresolved rules if no table is provided).

Details

Ambiguous sequences are sequences that appear under more than one species. These must be resolved before QC because downstream QC and curation assume that each sequence is assigned to a single species.

If a resolution_table is supplied, it should contain one row per ambiguous sequence and an action column:

  • "keep": keep the specified resolution.

  • "combine": combine records across species, pipe-joining values that differ across the ambiguous group.

  • "drop": remove the ambiguous sequence.

If no resolution_table is supplied, on_unresolved controls the behavior:

  • "stop": stop with an error.

  • "warn": warn and return the data unchanged.

  • "drop": warn and remove ambiguous rows.

See also

Other parsing: rb_ambiguity_utils, rb_parse_sources, rb_sequence_prep

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
combined <- rb_combine_sources(
  list(ncbi_parsed, bold_parsed),
  species_col = "species",
  sequence_col = "sequence"
)

resolved <- rb_resolve_ambiguous(
  combined,
  on_unresolved = "drop"
)
} # }
